About the show

NEORUINS Pod is the Outpost-side show from NEORUINS: real-world news and ideas, covered as they land — no Archive lore, no mysteries, just the briefing. It launched November 4, 2026, and is published by NEORUINS.

The series: AI Bots Briefing

The first series inside NEORUINS Pod tracks what AI assistants can actually do now — background work, new models, new abilities — and sorts the news that matters from the noise, one short episode at a time.
